jobs.occupation: Employer Branding & Internal Communications Specialist / Senior Specialist (m/f/d) (Employer-Branding-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. Job
Responsibilities Build Our Employer Brand Develop and implement
creative employer branding initiatives across channels such as
LinkedIn, our career website and employer review platforms. Create
compelling content, including copy, campaign concepts and ideas for
visual and video content. Bring employer branding campaigns from the
initial concept through to execution. Ensure our global employer brand
is reflected authentically in our local activities. Shape Internal
Communications Help build and develop our internal communication
channels, including digital platforms and employee newsletters.
Discover and share stories from across the organization that
strengthen our culture and foster engagement. Translate complex topics
into clear, engaging communication for employees. Support internal
events, town halls and culture initiatives that connect our growing
workforce. Collaborate Across Teams Work closely with colleagues
across HR and international stakeholders to ensure consistent and
effective communication. Act as a bridge between global corporate
communication principles and local implementation. Partner with HR and
Talent Acquisition to create a seamless employee and candidate
experience. Profile To be successful in this role, you should bring:
Professional experience in Employer Branding or Internal
Communications. Strong copywriting and storytelling skills with the
ability to create engaging content for different audiences. Excellent
communication skills in German and English (written and spoken). A
hands-on mindset with the motivation to turn ideas into action and
deliver results. The ability to work effectively with international
stakeholders in a multicultural environment. It would be a plus if you
also have: Experience building internal communication channels (e.g.
intranet, newsletters, employee communication platforms). Experience
with social media, employer branding campaigns or digital content
creation. Experience in a growing, international or greenfield
environment. Why Join ESMC? Make a Visible Impact Your ideas won’t
stay on presentation slides –they’ll become part of the culture of
one of Europe’s most exciting semiconductor projects. Build
Something New Join a true greenfield project where you’ll help shape
our employer brand and internal communications from the very
beginning. Enjoy Creative Ownership Bring your own ideas to life while
working within an international environment that values initiative,
collaboration and continuous improvement. Experience the Best of Both
Worlds Benefit from the agility and team spirit of a growing local
organization, backed by the strength and stability of global
technology leaders. Grow With Us As ESMC continues to expand, you’ll
have the opportunity to grow your role, broaden your expertise and
help shape the future of our organization Additional contact details
ESMC recruiting team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits
with hiring criteria. Thanks!

jobs.description:

engagierte/n: Equipment Engineer (m/f/d) – Start Date: 1 October
2026 At ESMC, the Equipment Engineer supports the installation,
maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of advanced
semiconductor manufacturing equipment in a cleanroom environment. As
part of a high-volume 24/7 fab operation, the role focuses on ensuring
tool performance, improving uptime, reducing defects, and supporting
stable production. The position requires openness to scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty, includes an initial induction and
training period in Dresden of one month, followed by one year of
on-the-job training in Taiwan. If you are interested in advancing your
career in semiconductor manufacturing, learning from one of the
world’s leading semiconductor companies, and joining an
international and diverse team on a unique learning journey, apply now
with your English CV. Tasks 1. Maintain equipment performance in a
cleanroom environment to support stable, high-quality production. 2.
Handle on-duty tasks and perform fundamental alarm troubleshooting. 3.
Install and qualify new tool sets according to project plans and
schedules. 4. Identify root causes and solve critical equipment
issues. 5. Improve tool uptime and availability while driving defect
reduction. 6. Identify and pursue opportunities for hardware
capability enhancement. 7. Build defense and monitoring systems to
prevent equipment failures and performance loss. 8. Manage vendor
relationships and act as module liaison with facilities, vendors, and
manufacturing shift personnel. 9. Support scheduled night shifts,
evening shifts, weekend work, on-duty assignments, and on-call duties
as required in a 24/7 high-volume manufacturing environment. Profile

1. Legally eligible to work in Germany. 2. Available for approximately
one year of on-the-job training in Taiwan. 3. Open for scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty. 4. Degree in electronics,
electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechanics,
mechatronics, material engineering, or an equivalent field. 5.
Practical experience in a mechanical or equipment-related field. 6.
Understanding of technical documentation and schematics. 7. Knowledge
of semiconductor manufacturing is a plus. 8. Fluent in English with
good command of German. 9. Hands-on working attitude with an open
mindset. 10. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 11. Able
to perform physical work on tools in a cleanroom environment.
Important Candidate Information: Start Date: This role is planned to
commence on October 1, 2026, in Dresden. Depending on your needs and
timeline preferences, January 1, 2027, can be considered as an
alternative start date. Onboarding and International Training: The
first month of your employment will be spent in Dresden. Following
this initial onboarding, training, and integration with your new team
members, you will travel to Taiwan for a one-year on-the-job training
and knowledge transfer program. Your training in Taiwan will involve
close collaboration with experienced TSMC engineering teams. You may
also receive additional training and support at TSMC’s
state-of-the-art Newcomer Training Center in Taichung. Training
Logistics: For employees requiring accommodation during the first
month in Dresden, and who reside more than 90 minutes away, ESMC will
organize appropriate temporary lodging. This provision does not apply
to employees who establish a residential address in Dresden (e.g., to
expedite work permit procedures away from their original place of
residence) or who terminate a personal lease contract in Dresden prior
to their planned departure to Taiwan. Furthermore, ESMC will organize
and provide air and ground transportation from Dresden to Taichung
(Taiwan) and back at the conclusion of the training. Accommodation in
Taiwan will be provided in one of TSMC’s modern and comfortable
company dormitories. Role Requirements and Expectations: This is a
unique opportunity to gain exposure to TSMC’s world-leading advanced
manufacturing practices and actively contribute to building ESMC from
the ground up. As a start-up organization, ESMC offers the opportunity
to play an active role in shaping the company’s culture, future
organization and ways of working. Candidates should be comfortable in
a dynamic environment where certain operational details such as
processes, documentation, shift structures, will continue to evolve
during the ramp-up phase. This role is ideal for individuals with a
strong growth mindset, a positive attitude, and a long-term
perspective. We offer Jede Reise beginnt mit dem ersten Schritt. Der

Ihr wahres Potenzial unter Beweis zu stellen. Sie werden in einem

jobs.occupation: Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - Quantum Mechanics and Modeling (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - Quantum Mechanics and Modeling

As a key player in our R&D digital transformation, you will leverage quantum mechanics, physics-based modeling, machine learning and AI to predict molecular properties, design and prioritize compounds across our discovery portfolio. Collaborating closely with medicinal chemists, structural biologists, biologists, and data engineers, you will drive discovery project milestones and advance our digital transformation in R&D. Your role is crucial in shaping the future of drug discovery and development through innovative digital solutions.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- You advance drug discovery projects using quantum mechanics, data science, and modeling approaches to enable data‑driven decision‑making.
- You enable AI‑augmented Design‑Make‑Test‑Analyze cycles by advancing and applying methods for in‑silico compound design and characterization.
- 
Applying cutting‑edge quantum mechanics methods to advance drug development and to generate a deep understanding of molecular interactions is central to your function

- You collaborate closely with experimentalists and internal partners to identify scientific challenges and develop effective solutions.
- You lead strategic digital initiatives and actively co‑shape the R&D digital strategy.
- Working closely with the Data Science & AI unit to leverage next‑generation technologies and drive the adoption of digital solutions is a core part of your role
- You share your skills and knowledge by coaching and teaching others, demonstrating collaborative and supportive behaviors.
- You contribute to self‑directed teams that work collaboratively and align with Bayer’s leadership standards.

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a PhD in quantum chemistry, computational chemistry, chemistry, computer science, or a related discipline, with strong knowledge of organic chemistry.
- Demonstrated success in an industry setting defines your professional track record, supported by extensive professional experience where you have utilized a diverse range of ligand‑ and structure‑based approaches, including virtual screening, docking, molecular dynamics, binding‑affinity calculations, generative design approaches, and holistic workflows
- You are proficient in quantum mechanics software such as ORCA and xTB, and you have experience in scripting, programming, and workflow automation
- You have experience working with AI‑driven DMTA loops in a pharmaceutical setting, as well as practical exposure to computational workflows that integrate AI, modeling, and chemistry
- You demonstrate high interest in managing high‑performance infrastructure and working with external IT providers
- You emb  holistic health principles and align your work with the organization’s vision as part of Bayer.
- Curiosity, creativity, and a strong passion for drug discovery are central characteristics that define you
- Fluency in English (written and spoken), with strong communication skills and the ability to present complex data clearly and effectively, round off your profile

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This position can be filled on a full-time or near full-time (min. 80%) basis.

WHAT WE OFFER

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Whether it’s hybrid work models or part-time arrangements: Whenever it is possible, you will have the flexibility to work how, when and where it is best for you.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.
- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

Be You. Be Bayer.

Introduction

The INM-Leibniz Institute for New Materials is an internationally leading center for interdisciplinary research on materials, and their exploitation in materials-based solutions for a sustainable world with increasing digitalization and medical needs. Our research integrates materials chemistry, biological engineering, physical analysis, process engineering and data science. We collaborate with academic and industrial partners all around the world.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.

Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

About Atari

Atari operates internationally with offices in the US, UK, in France, Germany, Sweden, and India.

About the role

Münster, Germany · Part-time

The Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator will provide executive, administrative and project coordination support to the CFO. Based in Germany and working closely with the CFO in France, you will help keep financial administration, corporate governance and cross-border operational matters moving to completion.

This is a practical coordination role for someone who is organised, persistent and comfortable following up with banks, lawyers, tax advisers, notaries, corporate service providers and internal teams. You will coordinate documents, signatures, banking administration, KYC and AML requests, legal entity changes and board formalities across the Atari Group.

You do not need to be an accountant or a technical finance specialist. You do need to be reliable with sensitive information, comfortable with formal processes and willing to chase the right people until an item is complete.

What you’ll do

- Provide day-to-day executive and administrative support to the CFO, coordinating priorities across Germany, France and the US.
- Coordinate the preparation, circulation, approval and execution of corporate documents, board resolutions, powers of attorney and other legal or finance documentation.
- Manage signature workflows, monitor outstanding actions and ensure documents are signed, returned and stored on time.
- Coordinate banking administration, including account openings and closures, bank mandates, signatory updates and KYC/AML requests.
- Maintain accurate corporate records and legal entity documentation, ensuring information is complete, current and easy to retrieve.
- Support legal entity shutdowns, entity administration and related projects by coordinating actions across Finance, Legal, tax advisers, banks and external service providers.
- Liaise with banks, external legal counsel, tax lawyers, corporate service providers, notaries and local finance teams on administrative and corporate matters.
- Coordinate board minutes, governance records, approvals, formalities and other recurring corporate requirements.
- Support finance-related administrative work, including gathering information, tracking deadlines, maintaining records and coordinating deliverables.
- Act as a project coordinator for cross-functional finance and governance workstreams, keeping owners aligned and following through on open items.
- Provide administrative support for certain Luxembourg-related matters and coordinate with the relevant internal and external contacts.
- Escalate delays, missing information, unclear ownership or material issues to the CFO or relevant functional lead.

Requirements & Qualifications

- Professional fluency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders.
- Experience in an administrative, executive support, banking, legal operations, paralegal, corporate services or similar coordination role.
- Strong organisation and follow-through, with the confidence to chase people, manage deadlines and keep multiple workstreams moving.
- Experience handling confidential information and formal documentation with accuracy and discretion.
- Comfort working with banks, lawyers, advisers, notaries, corporate service providers or other external stakeholders.
- Ability to work independently, prioritise changing requests and operate with flexibility when the CFO and key stakeholders are based in another country.
- Good judgement and attention to detail when coordinating governance, KYC/AML, banking and legal entity administration.

Nice to have

- Professional proficiency in French.
- Experience supporting a CFO, finance leader, executive team or European corporate function.
- Experience in a bank, financial institution, law office, corporate services provider or multinational business.
- Familiarity with KYC/AML processes, bank mandates, signatory administration, powers of attorney, board documentation or legal entity management.
- Experience coordinating entity closures, corporate reorganisations, acquisitions or other cross-border projects.
- Familiarity with Luxembourg corporate or finance administration.

How you’ll work

This role is about making sure important administrative and governance work does not sit unresolved. You will often be coordinating several parties at once, clarifying what is needed, tracking who owns the next step and following up until the document, approval, bank request or entity action is complete.

You will work closely with Finance and Legal, but you are not expected to provide accounting or legal advice. Your value will come from being dependable, organised and persistent, and from creating enough structure that the CFO and specialist advisers can make decisions and complete formalities efficiently.

The role requires flexibility in working hours to accommodate cross-border coordination with the CFO in France, banks, advisers and teams in other time zones.

Why join Atari

This role sits at the centre of an international finance and governance environment. You will work across Germany, France, Luxembourg and other Atari Group locations, helping coordinate the formalities and projects that support the Group’s entities and operations.

You will have visibility across Finance, Legal and senior leadership, with the opportunity to build a reliable operating rhythm for corporate administration and cross-border coordination as Atari continues to integrate and develop its international business.

Company

Rothe Erde is a leading provider of bearings and solutions that play a key role in wind, solar and tidal power plants, among other things. The segment employs around 12,000 people, who generated revenues of approximately 3.8 billion euros in fiscal year 2023/2024.

Your responsibilities

- You will actively contribute to the further development and effective implementation of the Compliance Management System within the Decarbon Technologies segment and take ownership of selected compliance areas, including anti-corruption, data compliance, anti-money laundering, and export control/trade compliance. A key focus of your role will be the provision of antitrust and competition law advice as well as the further development and implementation of competition law compliance measures.
- You will help ensure that segment-wide standards are adhered to, compliance risks are identified at an early stage, and regulatory requirements are implemented efficiently across the organization.
- As part of a holistic compliance approach, you will advise and support the business on additional compliance topics, particularly with regard to the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG) and related regulatory requirements.
- You will advise the companies within the thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies segment on a broad range of compliance matters. This includes, among other things, providing antitrust and competition law advice in MundA projects, addressing liability-related questions arising from the application of the Compliance Program, and supporting the coordination and enablement of Compliance Officers in the Business Units and regions. In doing so, you will contribute to the effective and consistent implementation of compliance requirements throughout the segment.
- You will support compliance reporting at segment and Group level, assist in the development of compliance processes, policies, concepts, and preventive measures, and accompany their implementation in an international environment.
- You will monitor and analyze regulatory developments and compliance risks, derive appropriate measures, and support their implementation.
- In addition, you will independently manage cross-functional compliance projects and actively drive the further development of the compliance organization and compliance culture within the segment.

Your profile

- You are passionate about working collaboratively and excited to contribute to the further evolution of Compliance at thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies during a period of transformation and growth.
- You hold an degree in Law and have successfully completed the Second German State Examination (Second State Exam) or possess an equivalent legal qualification. Additional qualifications, such as an LL.M. or other postgraduate degree, are considered an asset.
- You bring significant and recent experience in a senior compliance role within an international corporation or complex business environment. You have a proven track record of not only advising on compliance matters, but also shaping, implementing, and continuously improving compliance programs and governance frameworks.

- You are an effective communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust and credibility across all levels of the organization.
- You thrive in an international and cross-cultural environment and distinguish yourself through integrity, discretion, resilience, and a high level of personal accountability.
- You have successfully led complex, cross-functional, and international projects and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
- You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. German and Spanisch language skills are highly desirable.

Your benefits

At thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies, we are committed to providing an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. Our benefits include:

- The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by contributing to the continued growth and success of thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies in a dynamic and future-oriented industry.

The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computerscience, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in an unique constellation in Europe. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Tasks & responsibilities

- In this role, you will support strategic marketing initiatives for individual brand(s), including long-term category strategy development for a portfolio to support success in strategic markets based on deep customer understanding.
- With a strong strategic focus, you will drive the Brand Plan and strategy deployment, including strategic pricing guidance, category focus, geo expansion, and clear prioritization.
- Working closely with the Franchise Head/Senior Brand Manager, you will support the development of marketing campaigns for brand(s) across veterinary and/or non-veterinary channels, resulting in channel-specific portfolio campaigns.
- In close collaboration with GCB, you will support the Franchise Head in governing brand strategy execution, including KPI definition and brand equity tracking in strategic countries.
- As part of the portfolio team, you will contribute to defining life cycle management for current brands and future projects, including review of pipeline and BD&L initiatives.
- To enable successful execution, you will help define key strategic initiatives to achieve product targets, including must-win priorities.
- Additionally, you will drive digital transformation in marketing and promotion for brands and collaborate across the franchise and the wider pet business.
- Furthermore, you will support the development of brand guidance and brand positioning, ensuring that new and existing brands fit coherently into the portfolio and managing related changes (e.g. packaging, positioning, LCM).

Additional tasks for Senior Brand Manager role:

- Additionally, you will tailor brand strategies and strategic initiatives for (R)OPU archetypes, with a strong focus on strategic countries.
- Furthermore, you will define life cycle management for current brands and future projects, including review of pipeline and BD&L opportunities within the category.
- At the same time, you will lead the development of marketing campaigns across all relevant channels, with a strong emphasis on digital transformation.
- Beyond this, you will develop brand guidance and positioning, ensuring alignment of new and existing brands within the portfolio and steering changes such as packaging, positioning, and LCM.
- Finally, you will support the Franchise Head in overall franchise strategy development while being accountable for the brand/project budget and adherence.

Requirements

- University degree required; Master degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) highly desirable
- Highly specialized knowledge and work experience in different parts of business, including Marketing roles in local & regional roles. Sales role experience is desirable.
- Requires strong understanding of business operations across regional/local levels and different geographic specificities, portfolio specifics.
- Strong strategic marketing and analytical capabilities
- Fluent command of English

Additional requirements for Senior Brand Manager role:

- Long-term brand management experience; exposure to local and operational strategic marketing
- Proven project leadership and project management experience; budget and resource oversight
- Deep understanding of regional and local business operations, geographic specificities, and portfolio dynamics
- Strong stakeholder management skills; ability to influence and gain buy-in in a cross-cultural, matrixed environment
- Excellent strategic marketing mindset combined with strong analytical capabilities
- High agility; ability to evolve strategic and tactical approaches based on research data and industry trends

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.

The Position
Are you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.
The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.
- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.
- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.
- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.
- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.
- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.

Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:

- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.
- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.

Requirements

- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health
- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities
- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products
- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs
- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets
- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption
- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)
- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data
- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external context

Additional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:

- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities
- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis
- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication
- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)
